description: After style_battle: keeps the direction the person chose and removes the other directions’ artboards from that design (saved as a new version: the previous one stays in the design’s history). If the design is open in Paletoo, its signature effect (chrome, riso inks, VHS…) is applied live. Only for designs made by style_battle.

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

keep.description: the direction’s id (style_battle lists them) or its artboard id

name: keep_direction
title: Keep a direction
